1. ch29Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0090

Let $g(t)=v(t)^{-1}g_{S^2}$, $t\in (-\infty ,0)$, be a maximal ancient Ricci flow on the two-sphere. The positive function $v$ is called the pressure. In cylindrical and stereographic coordinates we write the same metric as \[ g(t)=\widehat v(t)^{-1}g_{\mathrm{cyl}} =\overline v(t)^{-1}g_{\mathrm{euc}}. \]
